# Contract: FinanceRepository

This feature has no external/network API (local-only, single-device — matching the rest of the app). The equivalent contract boundary is the **Domain repository interface**, which Presentation (via use cases) and Data (via `FinanceRepositoryImpl`) both depend on, per constitution Principle VI. All methods return `Either<Failure, T>` (Principle VII) — no method throws to the caller.

```dart
abstract class FinanceRepository {
  /// Records a new income or expense entry (FR-001/FR-002). [idempotencyKey]
  /// is generated by the caller at "Save" time; a retried call with the same
  /// key returns the already-persisted entry rather than creating a second
  /// one (FR-021). Rejects amountMinorUnits <= 0 (FR-003) and a categoryId
  /// whose Category.type does not match [type].
  Future<Either<Failure, FinanceEntry>> addEntry({
    required String idempotencyKey,
    required String categoryId,
    required FinanceEntryType type,
    required int amountMinorUnits,
    required DateTime date,
    String? note,
  });

  /// Edits amount/category/date/note of an existing entry (FR-019). [type]
  /// is re-derived from the (possibly new) category, not accepted directly,
  /// so an edit can never leave type/category mismatched. Sets editedAt.
  Future<Either<Failure, FinanceEntry>> editEntry({
    required String entryId,
    required String categoryId,
    required int amountMinorUnits,
    required DateTime date,
    String? note,
  });

  /// Soft-deletes an entry immediately (FR-020, research.md Decision 8) —
  /// the caller is responsible for showing the confirmation dialog and the
  /// undo affordance; this call itself is not reversible except via
  /// [restoreEntry].
  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> deleteEntry(String entryId);

  /// Un-sets deletedAt for an entry deleted within the current undo window
  /// (research.md Decision 8). A no-op success if the entry is not
  /// currently soft-deleted (defensive against a stale/duplicate undo tap).
  Future<Either<Failure, FinanceEntry>> restoreEntry(String entryId);

  /// Filtered, paginated history (FR-012/FR-013), newest date first.
  /// [filter] may narrow by type, categoryId, and/or a date range. Excludes
  /// soft-deleted rows.
  Future<Either<Failure, List<FinanceEntry>>> getHistory({
    FinanceHistoryFilter? filter,
    int limit = 50,
    int offset = 0,
  });

  /// Total income, total expenses, and net for [period] (FR-014),
  /// computed by SQL aggregate (research.md Decision 6), never by summing
  /// a fetched list client-side.
  Future<Either<Failure, FinanceSummary>> getSummary(DateRange period);

  /// Per-category totals for [period], descending by amount (FR-015).
  Future<Either<Failure, List<CategoryBreakdownItem>>> getCategoryBreakdown(
    DateRange period,
  );
}
```
